questions.title: GATE EC 2024 | Set 1 | Question: 15
questions.subject: Engineering Mathematics (EC)
questions.questionHtml:
Let $\rho(x, y, z, t)$ and $u(x, y, z, t)$ represent density and velocity, respectively, at a point $(x, y, z)$ and time $t$. Assume $\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t}$ is continuous. Let $V$ be an arbitrary volume in space enclosed by the closed surface $S$ and $\hat{n}$ be the outward unit normal of $S$.
Which of the following equations is/are equivalent $\frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t}+\nabla \cdot(\rho u)=0$ ?
options: $\int_{V} \frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} d v=-\oint_{S} \rho u \cdot \hat{n} d s$
$\int_{V} \frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} d v=\oint_{S} \rho u \cdot \hat{n} d s$
$\int_{V} \frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} d v=-\int_{V} \nabla \cdot(\rho u) d v$
$\int_{V} \frac{\partial \rho}{\partial t} d v=\int_{V} \nabla \cdot(\rho u) d v$

questions.questionHtml: The free electron concentration profile $n(x)$ in a doped semiconductor at equilibrium is shown in the figure, where the points $A, B$, and $C$ mark three different positions. Which of the following statements is/are true?
options: For $x$ between $\mathrm{B}$ and $\mathrm{C}$, the electron diffusion current is directed from $\mathrm{C}$ to $\mathrm{B}$.
For $x$ between $\mathrm{B}$ and $\mathrm{A}$, the electron drift current is directed from $\mathrm{B}$ to $\mathrm{A}$.
For $x$ between $\mathrm{B}$ and $\mathrm{C}$, the electric field is directed from $\mathrm{B}$ to $\mathrm{C}$.
For $x$ between $B$ and $A$. the electric field is directed from $A$ to $B$.
